Squire {{cut}} |quests = |level = |actor = |dialogue = |edid =LvlBoSScribe |formid ={{ID|00076A05}} |refid ={{ID|00121c7d}} }} '''Kerry''', referred to as a '''Brotherhood senior scribe''' in-game, is a deceased member of the [[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 76)|Brotherhood of Steel]] found dead on the roof of the [[Watoga Civic Center]]. ==Background== Kerry was killed on the rooftops of [[Watoga]] at some point prior to [[Timeline#2102|2102]].A reference exists for Kerry's body, using the template of a generic Brotherhood senior scribe corpse. It has the reference name of BoS_BodyKerryREF. {{FO76CC}} Kerry would have been involved in a cut quest to discover Kerry and [[Enrique Belmonte]]'s corpses. In this content, Kerry is referred to as a squire, not a scribe. Afterwards, the player character would have recorded their manner of death in a Brotherhood terminal, all the while being in direct contact with [[Roger Maxson]]. {{FO76CC|end}} ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel =Random Brotherhood apparel |weapon = |otheritem = |ondeath =empty }} ==Appearances== Kerry appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==References== {{References}} [[Category:Fallout 76 human characters]] [[Category:Fallout 76 Brotherhood of Steel characters]] [[ru:Керри (старший скриптор)]] [[zh:Kerry (Brotherhood)]]

We'll finish this later.|[[Ansel's holotape]]}} '''Ansel Abrahms''', referred to as '''Ansel''' in-game, is a deceased man in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Ansel was the grandfather of [[Dorothea]], a child who died of leukemia before the [[Great War]]. Dorothea had dreams of visiting [[Appalachia|West Virginia]] and wrote out a list of places she wanted to see. Determined to keep his word, Ansel went to Appalachia and set out to take pictures of those places with his camera in memory of Dorothea, but died before the list could be completed.[[Ansel's holotape]] ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |essential = |temp companion = |perm companion = |perk = |wares = |caps = |max condition = |heal = |cure addiction = |cure radiation = |rent = |items modified = |quests started =[[Bucket List]] |quests involved = }} ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel = |weapon = |otheritem =[[Ansel's holotape]]
[[Broken ProSnap Deluxe camera]]
[[My bucket list]] |ondeath = }} ==Possible locations== [[File: FO76 dead tourist locations.jpeg|thumb|Dead tourist locations]] Ansel's or [[Anne Litzinger]]'s corpses share a single spawn chance and will only spawn one time per server. The spawn location can be found by using [[My personal terminal]] and clicking the Suspicious Person option. Ansel's body has a chance to be found at the following locations: * [[Colonel Kelly monument]], lying on a bench outside the monument. * [[Tyler County Fairgrounds]], sitting on a chair next to a rock wall. * [[The Giant Teapot]], on a picnic table in front of the teapot. * [[Wavy Willard's Water Park]], in a car within the parking lot. * [[Miners Monument]], on the stairs leading to the monument. ==Appearances== Ansel Abrahms appears only {{In|FO76WA}}. ==Notes== Prior to the ''[[Expeditions: The Pitt]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]], Ansel's corpse was able to spawn at [[The Whitespring Resort]], near the entrance, on a red convertible. The update removed this spawn location as well as the [[Chryslus Cherry Bomb]] his body was draped over. ==Behind the scenes== Ansel is a reference to [[wikipedia:Ansel Adams|Ansel Adams]], an influential mid-20th century photographer known for capturing various landscapes of the American West. ==See also== * [[Anne Litzinger]] ==Gallery== Bucket List 01.png|Ansel at [[Colonel Kelly monument]] Fo76wa Ansel Abrahms kelly monument.png|Ansel at the Colonel Kelly monument Ansel Abrahms miners monument.png|Ansel at the [[Miners Monument]] FO76 Ansel Abrahms Whitespring Resort.png|Ansel at the now cut [[Whitespring Resort]] location Ansel Wavy Willards Park.png|Ansel at [[Wavy Willard's Water Park]] FO76WA Tyler County fairgrounds (Ansel corpse).jpg|Ansel at Tyler County Fairgrounds FO76 Location 12621 5.png FO76WA The Giant Teapot (Ansel corpse).png|Ansel at [[The Giant Teapot]] ==References== {{References}} [[Category:Wild Appalachia human characters]] [[fr:Ansel Abrahms]] [[ru:Ансель]]

We're all still pretending to be secret service agents. There's no president to protect. No government of any kind. What's the point? But being here beats being out there, so I put up with it.|sound=Cole Carver 00544699_1.ogg}} '''Cole "Slick" Carver''' is a [[Secret Service (Fallout 76)|Secret Service]] agent in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Cole operates as the liaison between outsiders and the Secret Service members in [[Vault 79]]. Unlike the other members, he prefers to do things diplomatically.[[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"What's your role here?"''
Slick: ''"I'm liason{{sic}}. Workin' with people. The others aren't so good with that. You know, all serious and shoot first arrest later. That's why I do most of the talking. Keeps everything from blowing up in our faces."''
([[Cole Carver/Dialogue#135|Slick's dialogue]]) In his spare time, he prefers to explore the [[vault]], and surprisingly still finds new things there.[[Reginald Stone's journal]] Cole was originally stationed in the vault prior to the [[Great War]] and managed to be one of the few agents to survive both [[Shorty (Wastelanders)|Shorty]]'s mutiny and the reactor malfunction. He also helped [[Mercedes Stern]] through her pregnancy.[[Chase Terrier's journal]] ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |essential = |temp companion = |perm companion = |ghoul =yes |perk = |wares = |caps = |max condition = |heal = |cure addiction = |cure radiation = |rent = |items modified = |quests started = |quests involved =* [[Secrets Revealed]] }} ===Quests=== * [[Secrets Revealed]]: Ever since the reactor malfunctioned, Slick has been trapped with other agents in a small area in the Vault. He must be rescued by purging the reactor area of radiation. ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel =[[Black suit (Wastelanders)|Dirty black suit]]

[[Pittsburgh Union|Union]] |role =Pet |location =[[The Trench]] hideaway |level = |derived = |special = |aggression = |confidence = |assistance = |factions = |class = |combat style= |CK race = |edid =XPD_Pitt02_FriendlyMongrel_Morley |refid ={{ID|0066403b}} |formid ={{ID|0066403c}} }} '''Morley''' is a [[Mongrel (Fallout 76)|mongrel dog]] who can be found within [[the Trench]] in [[The Pitt (Fallout 76)|The Pitt]]. ==Background== Morley was once the pet of [[Jaxon Reed]]. At some point, Jaxon Reed and Morley were separated when Jaxon fell through the ground. Jaxon was unable to return to the surface, and while dying regretted that he couldn't save his dog.[[My noose]] Unbeknownst to Jaxon, Morley survived and now resides with the members of the [[Pittsburgh Union|Union]] hiding away at a safehouse behind a waterfall in the Trench. ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |essential = }} ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel = |weapon = |otheritem = |ondeath = }} ==Notes== Morley can spawn as [[Fallout 76 legendary enemies|legendary]], despite being friendly and unable to be killed. ==Appearances== Morley appears only {{In|FO76TP}}. ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox Expeditions The Pitt}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unique creatures]] [[Category:Mongrel characters]]
